paper_level_summary_zh: 该文在射频唇读识别的相关工作介绍中，将目标论文作为利用毫米波感知扬声器振动的代表性工作之一，并指出毫米波雷达能够检测微小振动，但无法穿透厚砖墙。属于普通的相关工作列举，未对目标论文的能力进行具体肯定或使用。

evidences.evidence_quote: Most related studies utilized millimeter waves to penetrate low-loss wall materials (such as wood, glass, and soundproofing materials) to directly or indirectly detect the content played in speakers behind walls [18], [19], [20] rather than the lip movements.
evidences.evidence_context: Most related studies utilized millimeter waves to penetrate low-loss wall materials (such as wood, glass, and soundproofing materials) to directly or indirectly detect the content played in speakers behind walls [18], [19], [20] rather than the lip movements. Millimeter-wave radar, characterized by its short wavelength and high sensitivity can detect the minute vibrations of a speaker. However, its sensing capability is limited, and it cannot penetrate through the thicker brick walls.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., "Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration," Proc. ACM Interact. Mob. Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用是普通相关工作中的分组引用，目标论文与[19]、[20]共同被列为利用毫米波检测扬声器振动的相关工作，未单独描述目标论文的具体贡献或能力，且未提及 RFID 或亚毫米级感知。
